title: Agentic-Level Adversarial Purification: Revisiting Diffusion Purifiers on Native-Resolution Agentic Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.34181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language agents act on native-resolution renders of multi-element pages, where one perturbed photo or a few altered text strokes can redirect the decision. Any content provider can craft such a perturbation on the open model behind the agent, so a plug-in purifier is the natural first line of defense. Yet diffusion purifiers were designed and evaluated at the fixed resolution of the diffusion model on classifier or natural-image benchmarks, and defense evaluations for agents test JPEG, blur and noise but no diffusion purifier. We present the first study of adversarial purification at the agentic level, for an agent built on Qwen3-VL-8B: purifiers run at native resolution on multi-element inputs, face grey-box attackers who know the agent's model but not the defense, and are compared at matched clean cost. translated_title: 智能体级对抗净化：在原生分辨率智能体输入上重新审视扩散净化器
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言智能体在多元素页面的原生分辨率渲染图像上执行操作，其中一张被扰动的照片或几笔被篡改的文字就可能改变其决策。任何内容提供者都可以在智能体背后的开放模型上制造这种扰动，因此插件式净化器是自然的第一道防线。然而，扩散净化器此前是在扩散模型的固定分辨率下、针对分类器或自然图像基准进行设计和评估的，而针对智能体的防御评估只测试了JPEG压缩、模糊和噪声，从未测试过扩散净化器。我们首次在智能体层面研究对抗净化，研究对象是基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建的智能体：净化器在原生分辨率下处理多元素输入，面对知晓智能体模型但不知晓防御机制的灰盒攻击者，并在匹配的干净性能代价下进行比较。我们表明，将智能体输入当作分类器输入来处理会同时误导评估与设计——将输入缩放到该分辨率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次在智能体层面研究对抗净化，基于Qwen3-VL-8B智能体在原生分辨率多元素输入上评估扩散净化器，并揭示将智能体输入当作分类器输入处理会同时误导评估与设计。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first study of adversarial purification at the agentic level, evaluating diffusion purifiers on native-resolution multi-element inputs for a Qwen3-VL-8B-based agent, and shows that treating agentic inputs as classifier inputs misleads both evaluation and design.
